- Overestimate prices after sentiment spikes (especially >0.7) — model tends to overshoot in bullish phases.
- Underestimate prices during low sentiment (sentiment <0.3) — model fails to capture downward pressure.
- Lag in correction: model often delays reacting to sentiment shifts — especially when sentiment drops, forecast stays high.
- Mean reversion bias: model overweights recent highs and underweights lows — correct by smoothing out extreme recent values.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts overreact to short-term sentiment — reduce forecast amplitude if sentiment is volatile or recent.
- Avoid “sudden spike” overcorrection — after a sharp price rise, model often overcorrects downward, missing continuation.
